tools.name: health_catalog
tools.description: List the 43 documented Google Health data types, allowed operations, and required OAuth scopes.

user_google_email.description: Google account with stored Health OAuth consent; defaults to GOOGLE_DEFAULT_USER_EMAIL.

tools.name: health_list_data_points
tools.description: List Google Health records for a documented data type. Use page_token for the next page.

user_google_email.description: Google account with stored Health OAuth consent; defaults to GOOGLE_DEFAULT_USER_EMAIL.

data_type.description: One of the dataType IDs returned by health_catalog.

tools.name: health_get_data_point
tools.description: Read one Google Health record by data type and point ID.

user_google_email.description: Google account with stored Health OAuth consent; defaults to GOOGLE_DEFAULT_USER_EMAIL.

data_type.description: One of the dataType IDs returned by health_catalog.

point_id.description: The final ID segment of a users/me/dataTypes/{data_type}/dataPoints/{point_id} resource.

tools.name: health_create_data_point
tools.description: Create a Google Health record where the selected data type supports create. Use nutrition-log for calories consumed and exercise for workout sessions.

user_google_email.description: Google account with stored Health OAuth consent; defaults to GOOGLE_DEFAULT_USER_EMAIL.

data_type.description: One of the dataType IDs returned by health_catalog.

body.description: Google Health API v4 request body for this operation.

tools.name: health_update_data_point
tools.description: Update a Google Health record owned by the OAuth client where the data type supports update.

user_google_email.description: Google account with stored Health OAuth consent; defaults to GOOGLE_DEFAULT_USER_EMAIL.

data_type.description: One of the dataType IDs returned by health_catalog.

point_id.description: The final ID segment of a users/me/dataTypes/{data_type}/dataPoints/{point_id} resource.

body.description: Google Health API v4 request body for this operation.

tools.name: health_delete_data_points
tools.description: Delete 1 to 100 records of one Google Health data type owned by the OAuth client.

user_google_email.description: Google account with stored Health OAuth consent; defaults to GOOGLE_DEFAULT_USER_EMAIL.

data_type.description: One of the dataType IDs returned by health_catalog.

tools.name: health_reconcile_data_points
tools.description: Reconcile Google Health records where the data type supports reconciliation.

user_google_email.description: Google account with stored Health OAuth consent; defaults to GOOGLE_DEFAULT_USER_EMAIL.

data_type.description: One of the dataType IDs returned by health_catalog.

tools.name: health_rollup_data_points
tools.description: Aggregate Google Health records using a v4 RollUpDataPointsRequest body.

user_google_email.description: Google account with stored Health OAuth consent; defaults to GOOGLE_DEFAULT_USER_EMAIL.

data_type.description: One of the dataType IDs returned by health_catalog.

body.description: Google Health API v4 request body for this operation.

tools.name: health_daily_rollup_data_points
tools.description: Aggregate Google Health records by day using a v4 DailyRollUpDataPointsRequest body.

user_google_email.description: Google account with stored Health OAuth consent; defaults to GOOGLE_DEFAULT_USER_EMAIL.

data_type.description: One of the dataType IDs returned by health_catalog.

body.description: Google Health API v4 request body for this operation.

tools.name: health_export_exercise_tcx
tools.description: Export one exercise record as TCX, capped at 1 MB.

user_google_email.description: Google account with stored Health OAuth consent; defaults to GOOGLE_DEFAULT_USER_EMAIL.

point_id.description: The final ID segment of a users/me/dataTypes/{data_type}/dataPoints/{point_id} resource.
